plan_owner_impacts.impact: Chapter-tab navigation (12 persistent edge tabs + Home/All) is a candidate primary geometry; chapter pages keep stable scroll position per route (scroll memory) which implies a route-keyed view-state contract in the Settings shell plan.
Provider detail tabs (overview/accounts/models/install/limits/logs) propose a canonical sectioning for the provider card; deferred insertion for Installation stays inside the install tab.

settings_inventory_impacts.impact: No new inventory rows introduced; the concept renders the verbatim 828-row inventory (PMInventoryData) plus manager-local fixture rows that are demo-only and must not enter the inventory.

settings_schema_impacts.impact: Legacy scope metadata (e.g. scope: ["global"]) is preserved for provenance but never rendered as an editable scope; project-only presentation is the concept's contract (see plan-owner-delta.md).

command_id_impacts.impact: See candidate-command-delta.json; all IDs provisional census reuse/alias/candidate against authority/base_packet/CANDIDATE_COMMAND_ID_REGISTER.json.

dry_component_impacts.impact: See candidate-dry-delta.json; presentation-only reuse of headless modules (PMState2/PMSearch2/PMCopy2/PMManagers2); no second state owner created.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Concept persists demo state under localStorage key pm.settings-demo2.concept-09-tome-tabs (PMState2) and manager fixture values under pm.tt9.fx; both namespaced, no shared storage keys.

migration_supersession_impacts.impact: Supersedes legacy assumptions listed in machine_readable/supersessions.json (four concepts; collective coverage; editable scopes); concepts 01-04 frozen and untouched.
